Elle is an NPC on the  Crimson Isle. She acts as a guide, and helps explain the new systems, factions and mobs there.

Contents

  • 1 Quests
  • 2 Dialogue
  • 3 UI
  • 4 Trivia
  • 5 History
  • 6 Navigation

Quests

[edit | edit source]

Elle is one of the main NPCs for the Crimson Isle Main Questline for both Factions. She first appears in the  Stronghold trying to fight three Blazes, after which she tasks the player with bringing her  4 Magma Chunk,  3 Blaze Ashes and  2 Spectre Dust. After the player does this, Elle will start leaving the Stronghold.

She will be in front of the  Chief's Hut within  Dragontail, and outside the  Community Center within  Scarleton. She will then task the player with speaking to four NPCs from each Faction, so that they can make their mind up about which one they want to join. The quest then splits depending on which faction was chosen.

Elle is also required to access the Basic Tier of the Kuudra fight. She will take the player there after they have completed their Faction's entire questline.

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Before killing the 3 Blazes Random
[NPC] Elle: ONE SECOND I'M PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!
[NPC] Elle: COULD YOU HELP ME INSTEAD OF JUST SITTING THERE?!
After killing the 3 Blazes
[NPC] Elle: Wow, that was something!
[NPC] Elle: I'm immune to fire but those monsters are still quite troublesome...
[NPC] Elle: Thanks for your help, I seriously appreciate that.
[NPC] Elle: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though. I need to collect 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks and I'm super late.
[NPC] Elle: Will you help me?
Select an option: [NO] [YES]
If you haven't selected [YES] yet
[NPC] Elle: Will you help me?
Select an option: [NO] [YES]
Selecting [NO]
[NPC] Elle: Okay, that's fine. I just won't be able to buy food today and I won't be able to pay my rent.
[NPC] Elle: I might also die finding those items and you'll have that on your conscience.
[NPC] Elle: Have a nice day.
Selecting [YES]
[NPC] Elle: Thanks! You seem pretty strong, all you have to do is exterminate some of the monsters around. Follow me!
After Elle moves to the center of the  Stronghold
[NPC] Elle: Here, some of the mobs are inside that building and some are on the outside if you follow the path. Piece of cake!
[NPC] Elle: I need 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
Before giving the requested items Random
[NPC] Elle: Most monsters around drop valuable items, you can make a living killing them.
[NPC] Elle: I'll be right there, I need to catch my breath.
[NPC] Elle: I needed 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
Giving the requested items
-3 Blaze Ashes
-4 Magma Chunk
-2 Spectre Dust
[NPC] Elle: Oh, you already got everything?
[NPC] Elle: Yoink!
[NPC] Elle: Thanks for the items, that's super nice of you!
[NPC] Elle: You are new around here, right? Never seen you before.
[NPC] Elle: You are probably wondering what the heck happened to this place?
[NPC] Elle: This land actually used to be a peaceful forest with farmers, a long long time ago.
[NPC] Elle: When the Emperor Dragon destroyed the world something awakened deep below the surface.
[NPC] Elle: The giant volcano emerged and it kept on growing, over the centuries the whole place changed for the worse.
[NPC] Elle: I've really got to go now but if you are interested I suggest you explore the island a bit more.
[NPC] Elle: Thanks for your help, see you around!
Before attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut Random
[NPC] Elle: Why don't you explore the Village a bit more?
[NPC] Elle: You don't need to follow me everywhere you know?
Attempting to enter  Throne Room
[NPC] Elle: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Queen!
Attempting to enter  Chief's Hut
[NPC] Elle: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Chief!
Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
[NPC] Elle: There are 2 different Factions on this island with incredible tensions between them!
[NPC] Elle: They don't mind travelers but you have to earn their trust before you can do such things.
[NPC] Elle: In fact, you'll have to choose a faction, but it's a little bit early for that.
[NPC] Elle: Joining a faction is an important choice, I suggest you get to know the two factions first.
[NPC] Elle: Perhaps you should start by talking to multiple villagers from each faction.
[NPC] Elle: The other faction is on the other side of the island.
Whilst talking to villagers from both Factions Random
[NPC] Elle: The history between the 2 factions is long and complicated.
[NPC] Elle: Talk to the villagers and come back to me.
[NPC] Elle: Make sure you also talk to villagers from the other faction before you make your choice.
Talking to Villagers in Both Factions
[NPC] Elle: So you talked to a few villagers from both factions? Nice.
[NPC] Elle: I hope you know which faction you want to join. But don't worry, you'll be able to change factions if you want.
[NPC] Elle: However, changing factions usually means that you become unfriendly with your current faction.
[NPC] Elle: Anyways, which faction did you choose?
Select an option: [BARBARIANS] [MAGES]

The following dialogue appears when joining or on the Mage Faction:

Condition Dialogue
Joining Mage Faction
[NPC] Elle: Hum, so you chose the Mage Faction then.
[NPC] Elle: It's not going to be easy to join them.
[NPC] Elle: You first have to prove your worth if you want to have a chance at joining their ranks.
[NPC] Elle: Hum, let me think...
[NPC] Elle: Oh! I know what you should do!
[NPC] Elle: The Taika people really like educated individuals.
[NPC] Elle: If you can bring them back a book or a piece of technology they have never seen before, I'm sure they will take a liking to you.
[NPC] Elle: I couldn't help but notice that you come from the place we commonly know as The Hub.
[NPC] Elle: In which case, you must have met Maddox?
[NPC] Elle: Both Maddox and his brother are in fact from Scarleton, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the 2 brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
[NPC] Elle: In fact, they instead showed that they had immense strength, and a taste for violence.
[NPC] Elle: They got banned from the Academy during their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.
[NPC] Elle: But I digress. My point is they are both Taika, and I know for a fact that Aatrox is crafting simple Ability Phones for his brother.
[NPC] Elle: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from Maddox. I keep losing them.
After obtaining the Maddox Batphone
[NPC] Elle: Bring this to the Dean of the Academy in Scarleton, I'm sure he will find it quite interesting.
[NPC] Elle: The Cathedral got reorganized a while ago, now a large portion of it is used for the Academy.
After calling Dean
[NPC] Elle: Oh wow, it worked! I'm so happy for you!
[NPC] Elle: And you even got an Abiphone! Take my contact so we can stay in touch.
✆ Elle has been added to your Abiphone's contacts!
[NPC] Elle: Nice! So what are you up to?
[NPC] Elle: The Dean told you his research got stolen?!
[NPC] Elle: Ah, it's not so surprising, maybe you don't know but the Piglins are not so fond of the Taika people.
[NPC] Elle: I do have an idea where that stolen research might be, follow me.
Arriving outside The Bastion
[NPC] Elle: You see this giant Dragon Skull inside the Barbarian Faction?
[NPC] Elle: That's the skeleton of Jythar the Eternal one - the one who caused the destruction of the world.
[NPC] Elle: Now you probably understand why the village in front is called Dragontail.
[NPC] Elle: Anyways, the Barbarians built their Bastion inside the skeleton, and I suspect this is where the stolen object is guarded.
[NPC] Elle: Piglins fear the growing power of the Taika Kingdom, so they most likely stole it to study the research.
[NPC] Elle: Maybe you could sneak in and recover the item. Without getting seen and creating a major diplomatic incident, of course.
[NPC] Elle: I'm not sure exactly where they keep it, but just make sure you don't get seen by the guards!
[NPC] Elle: I can't help you however, I have way too much to lose sorry. But good luck!
Before recovering the stolen research Random
[NPC] Elle: Piglins can't see very far because of the fog, just don't stand in front of them.
[NPC] Elle: Do you even know what you are looking for? Maybe a book or a magical item?
After recovering the stolen research
✆ Elle: ✆
✆ Ring... [PICK UP]
✆ Ring... Ring... [PICK UP]
✆ Ring... Ring... Ring... [PICK UP]
[NPC] Elle: ✆ Hello? Oh, you are still alive, awesome!
[NPC] Elle: ✆ Have you got the research back or did you chicken out?
[NPC] Elle: ✆ Great! You are cooler than you look!
[NPC] Elle: ✆ Go back to the Dean then, I'm sure this will grant you a lot of reputation!
[NPC] Elle: ✆ Alright then! I have to go now, was nice talking to you!

The following dialogue appears when joining or on the Barbarian Faction:

Condition Dialogue
Joining Barbarian Faction
[NPC] Elle: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hum.
[NPC] Elle: What a strange choice.
[NPC] Elle: In any case, I have no idea how to guarantee your entry in their faction!
[NPC] Elle: But let's not get discouraged just yet, we'll find something I'm sure.
[NPC] Elle: Piglins crave Sulphur. Our first goal should be to find some.
[NPC] Elle: There are only 2 ways to get Sulphur.
[NPC] Elle: You either wait for the Volcano to erupt, or you find a Corrupted Monster.
[NPC] Elle: And guess what, I know where to look!
[NPC] Elle: Follow me!
Switching to the Barbarian Faction
[NPC] Elle: So you want to join the Barbarian Faction then...
[NPC] Elle: I do have an idea how you could do it.
[NPC] Elle: Piglins crave Sulphur. Our first goal should be to find some.
[NPC] Elle: There are only 2 ways to get Sulphur.
[NPC] Elle: You either wait for the Volcano to erupt, or you find a Corrupted Monster.
[NPC] Elle: And guess what, I know where to look!
[NPC] Elle: Follow me!

[NPC] Elle: Look, we found one! A Corrupted Monster!
[NPC] Elle: It's just ahead of us, the Burning Spider!
[NPC] Elle: Go fight it, good luck!
After killing the Corrupted Flaming Spider
[NPC] Elle: You handled that quite well.
[NPC] Elle: Corrupted Monsters rarely appear on the island, it usually means they consumed too much Sulphur.
 
[NPC] ----: Oink
 
[NPC] Elle: Did you hear that?
[NPC] Elle: I think it was coming from here!
[NPC] Elle: Let's go.
After finding the pig
[NPC] Elle: This Piglin got lost!
[NPC] Elle: They probably got cornered by monsters and had to hide here.
[NPC] Elle: Piglins turn back into pigs if they go too long without Sulphur.
[NPC] Elle: That Corrupted Monster should have dropped some Sulphur. Quick, give it to them!
Talking to Ugo after giving  Sulphur
[NPC] Ugo: You saved me!
[NPC] Ugo: Memory is failing me but I think I remember getting attacked.
[NPC] Ugo: My leg got hurt and I had to hide here, the rest is blurry...
 
[NPC] Elle: How could you leave Dragontail without Sulphur on you!
 
[NPC] Ugo: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for...
[NPC] Ugo: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!!
 
[NPC] Elle: Let's not exaggerate.
 
[NPC] Ugo: You don't understand, my father is the Chief!
 
[NPC] Elle: You were not exaggerating.
 
[NPC] Ugo: Please help me, I have to present myself to him.
 
[NPC] Elle: Of course.
[NPC] Elle: I will shoulder you to the Chief's Hut.
[NPC] Elle: <player> make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there.
Whilst Chief Scorn Scolds Ugo
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Ugo, where have you been?
 
[NPC] Ugo: I-
 
[NPC] Chief Scorn: You had ONE job!
[NPC] Chief Scorn: 3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!?
 
[NPC] Ugo: Well-
 
[NPC] Chief Scorn: And you two, what are your names?
 
[NPC] Elle: I'm-
 
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Thank you for saving my rascal of a son.
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Are you looking to join our ranks?
 
[NPC] Elle: No but-
 
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Perfect!
[NPC] Chief Scorn: I welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction!
[NPC] Chief Scorn: If you betray us you'll die.
 
[NPC] Elle: I can't-
 
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Enough talking!
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Ugo, go back out there and finish the job!
 
[NPC] Ugo: But-
 
[NPC] Chief Scorn: Guards, escort them out of my Hut!
Talking to Ugo afterwards
[NPC] Ugo: My leg really hurts.
[NPC] Ugo: It was already quite bad before this fall but now...
 
[NPC] Elle: Your father sure has some character.
 
[NPC] Ugo: He's not that bad, you get used to it.
 
[NPC] Elle: I don't know what he wants you to do out there, but we can't let you go back there with your injured leg.
 
[NPC] Ugo: I'm afraid I have to.
 
[NPC] Elle: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you.
 
[NPC] Ugo: I can't tell you it's highly confidential.
 
[NPC] Elle: I don't care, you can't go back out there with a broken leg.
 
[NPC] Ugo: Sigh
[NPC] Ugo: My father believes that the Mage Faction is working on some kind of powerful war instrument.
[NPC] Ugo: We know they are hiding something inside their Cathedral.
[NPC] Ugo: My job is to infiltrate their Cathedral and steal their war machine so we can study it.
 
[NPC] Elle: Say no more, that's a perfect job for <player>.
 
[NPC] Ugo: Why them?
 
[NPC] Elle: Alright let's go.
Arriving Outside Cathedral
[NPC] Elle: This is the Mage Cathedral.
[NPC] Elle: Your job is to enter the Cathedral and find the Dean's office.
[NPC] Elle: They are probably hiding the research there.
[NPC] Elle: There are multiple entrances, most of them have guards but this one down there is often unprotected.
[NPC] Elle: Good luck, I'll be right there in case you need moral support.
Before stealing the research
[NPC] Elle: Don't get caught by the guards!
[NPC] Elle: The Dean's office? I don't know where it is.
[NPC] Elle: It's definitely in their Cathedral though, I know they reorganized a lot of it into an Academy.
After stealing the research (Calling)
✆ Elle: ✆
✆ Ring... [PICK UP]
✆ Ring... Ring... [PICK UP]
✆ Ring... Ring... Ring... [PICK UP]
After stealing the research
(Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
[NPC] Elle: You got the right item?
[NPC] Elle: Are you sure?
[NPC] Elle: Okay great, let's leave this place. I have Mycelium all over my shoes.
[NPC] Elle: Let's talk to Ugo again.
[NPC] Elle: I'll use a Travel Scroll, see you there.

The following dialogue is not Faction-specific:

Condition Dialogue
Upon meeting in the  Forgotten Skull
[NPC] Elle: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
[NPC] Elle: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
[NPC] Elle: A monstruous[sic] creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
[NPC] Elle: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!
 
[NPC] Captain Ahone: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.
[NPC] Captain Ahone: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
[NPC] Captain Ahone: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.
 
[NPC] Ugo: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!
[NPC] Ugo: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!
 
[NPC] Elle: ENOUGH!
[NPC] Elle: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!
[NPC] Elle: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
[NPC] Elle: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.
[NPC] Elle: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.
 
[NPC] Captain Ahone: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
[NPC] Captain Ahone: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.
 
[NPC] Ugo: I agree, let's get inside.
After the meeting in the  Forgotten Skull
[NPC] Elle: <player> if you know other strong adventurers, now is the time to bring them.
[NPC] Elle: This monster is something else, trust me.
[NPC] Elle: Are you ready to fight?
Select an option: [YES] [NO]
Selecting [NO]
[NPC] Elle: Come back when you are ready, hurry up!
Before defeating Kuudra
[NPC] Elle: Are you ready?
Select an option: [YES] [NO]
Selecting [YES]
(A menu opens)
[NPC] Elle: Perfect! Let's fight!
Right after defeating Kuudra for the first time
[NPC] Elle: What a fight!
 
[NPC] Ugo: And we got all the Sulphur back!
[NPC] Ugo: But what exactly was that monster?
 
[NPC] Captain Ahone: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
[NPC] Captain Ahone: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.
 
[NPC] Ugo: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.
 
[NPC] Captain Ahone: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.
[NPC] Ugo: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly.
[NPC] Ugo: You too <player>, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you
 
[NPC] Captain Ahone: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste.
 
[NPC] Ugo: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go.
 
[NPC] Elle: Is anyone going to thank me?
Before continuing the quest after defeating Kuudra Random
[NPC] Elle: Thanks for sticking around, you looked real cool out there!
[NPC] Elle: I really have to do everything around here.
In  Kuudra's End or  Kuudra's Hollow
[NPC] Elle: Talk with me to begin!
Starting Kuudra fight in  Kuudra's End
[NPC] Elle: Okay adventurers, I will go fish up Kuudra!
[NPC] Elle: Head over to the main platform, I will join you when I get a bite!
[NPC] Elle: THE KUUDRA IS COMING!
[NPC] Elle: It's coming!
[NPC] Elle: A lava kraken, Kuudra!
[NPC] Elle: This one is Angry!
[NPC] Elle: THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!
Starting Kuudra fight in  Kuudra's Hollow
(Not all players have defeated Kuudra)
[NPC] Elle: Okay adventurers, I will go and fish up Kuudra!
[NPC] Elle: Head over to the main platform, I will join you when I get a bite!

[NPC] Elle: Wait... I think I've hooked onto something!

[NPC] Elle: Uh oh.
Starting Kuudra fight in  Kuudra's Hollow
(All players have defeated Kuudra)
[NPC] Elle: Okay adventurers, I will go and fish up Kuudra!
[NPC] Elle: Head over to the main platform, I will join you when I get a bite!

[NPC] Elle: Phew... that was close!
[NPC] Elle: ARGH! All of the supplies fell into the lava! You need to retrieve them quickly!
[NPC] Elle: Use your Lava Fishing Rods to pull them closer to the platform and collect them!
[NPC] Elle: I'll help you clear out Kuudra's minions, go fetch my supplies!
When all supplies are collected to the center
[NPC] Elle: OMG! Great work collecting my supplies!
[NPC] Elle: Now... please just cover me for a few minutes, I'll put together our special weapon!
[NPC] Elle: It's time to build the Ballista again! Cover me!
When Kuudra submerges after collecting the supplies
[NPC] Elle: What the hell is that noise?! I think we've made him mad!
[NPC] Elle: Looks like the horde is coming! Cover me!
Attempting to damage Kuudra with regular weapons
[NPC] Elle: Damaging Kuudra directly is futile. His thick skin is impenetrable with conventional weapons!
When Kuudra damages the Ballista
[NPC] Elle: BRUH
[NPC] Elle: That's a lot of damage!
[NPC] Elle: I'm sure that'll buff out... I hope..
[NPC] Elle: Argh, that didn't sound healthy.
[NPC] Elle: Guys!! You need to focus the tentacles!
When Energized Chunks spawn
[NPC] Elle: Those Energized Chunks really pack a punch when they explode! Try hitting them towards Kuudra!
When a Dropship spawns
[NPC] Elle: A Dropship is approaching! Take it down before it's too late!
When multiple Dropships spawn
[NPC] Elle: A fleet of Dropships are approaching! Take them down before it's too late!
When Magma Followers spawn

When Wandering Blazes spawn
[NPC] Elle: A group of Wandering Blazes are emerging from Kuudra's mouth!
When the Ballista is built (Basic Tier and Hot Tier)
[NPC] Elle: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blows now!
[NPC] Elle: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it must have fallen in the lava with the rest of my supplies!
[NPC] Elle: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to shoot him with the Ballista!
When the Ballista is built (Burning Tier, Fiery Tier and Infernal Tier)
[NPC] Elle: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blow!
[NPC] Elle: We need to find fuel for the Ballista, it must be fallen into the lava with the rest of my supplies!
[NPC] Elle: Huh, what is that noise?
[NPC] Elle: Whow...WHOW! What's happening!!
Elle has been eaten by Kuudra!
When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is outside
[NPC] Elle: *muffles*Help! I'm still alive in here! It stinks!
[NPC] Elle: *muffles*I think I'm in Kuudra's Belly! I was standing too close!
[NPC] Elle: *muffles*See if you can find a way to get in here too! I see something which may help us kill Kuudra!
When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is inside
[NPC] Elle: Oh, funny seeing you here.
[NPC] Elle: What? Yes I am still alive. I landed in Kuudra's belly here.
[NPC] Elle: It looks like if we mine these purple pods, we can do some real damage to Kuudra!
[NPC] Elle: Oh come on! What is it this time!
[NPC] Elle: I'll fight the mobs, you focus on destroying these pods!

[NPC] Elle: The lava level is rising inside Kuudra! He must have submerged under the lava!
[NPC] Elle: We need to get out before we burn in this lava!
[NPC] Elle: We can escape back out his throat at the top of his stomach!
[NPC] Elle: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah

When Kuudra is stunned

When Kuudra dies in Basic Tier, Hot Tier, Burning Tier and Fiery Tier
[NPC] Elle: POW! SURELY THAT'S IT! I don't think he has any more in him!
[NPC] Elle: I knew you could do it!
[NPC] Elle: One last flail before admitting defeat, huh?
[NPC] Elle: Good job everyone. A hard fought battle come to an end. Let's get out of here before we run into any more trouble!
When Kuudra's Lair is opening in Infernal Tier

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Elle is currently the most animated NPC. She fights mobs in the Kuudra fights, uses an Aspect of the End to escape the collapsing bridge cutscene and is one of the NPCs that can walk smoothly.
  • Elle uses a Diamond Pickaxe and a Diamond Sword during Kuudra fights.
  • If players manage to all die at 100% completion in a Kuudra fight, Elle will still congratulate them as if they had won.
  • When Elle requests you to talk to four villagers from each Faction, only certain ones count, which are indicated by green particles above their head.
    • In  Scarleton, these include Mage Emissary, Colore, Alwin, Offea, Ulyn, Mollim, Lys, Kheharad, Rhanora, Seffea, Rollim, Ezekiel, Mazakala, Arbadak, Arba, Velyna, Igrupan, and Scholar Alluin.
    • In  Dragontail, these include Barbarian Emissary, An, Suus, Turd, Kutral, Nall, Grog, Nuvian, Chihai, Chak, Chuk, Etc, Strux, Baar, Yoink, Pomtair, Truu, Plenk, Bruuh, Kaus, Igor, Porc, and Jine,
